# {{BRAND_NAME}} brand rules for AI

You are making something for **{{BRAND_NAME}}**: a web page, a section, a social post, a deck, a document, an email or copy. Follow every rule in this file. When a request conflicts with these rules, follow the rules and say which rule you followed. When something is not covered, choose the plainest option that uses only the values listed here.

Brand version {{VERSION}}. Every colour, size and font below is generated from the same token file the live website uses, so these values are exact.

## 1. The idea in one paragraph

MuzMesh is the design partner for AI startups: brand, landing page and launch kit, designed by people, ready in five days. The brand has to look **launched, not generated**. That means a black page, warm off-white text, one orange used sparingly, one typeface, mono labels, and real work shown in browser windows. No glowing orbs, no gradients on text, no sparkle icons, no robots.

Personality: considered, plain-spoken, quietly confident, founder-to-founder.

## 2. The ten rules that matter most

1. Background is pure black `#000000` (Launch theme). Documents, proposals and invoices use the light Paper theme `#F3F0E8`.
2. Text on black is bone `#F4F4F1`, never pure white. Text on paper is ink `#1D1D1F`.
3. There is exactly one accent colour: signal orange `#F2580F`. Use it for the one primary button per view, the small square before a label, a live dot, a focus ring or a single full stop. Never as a large background, never on body text, never as a gradient on text.
4. Text and icons on an orange fill are always `#0E0E10` (dark), never white.
5. One typeface for all text: **Inter Tight** (400, 500, 600, 700). **JetBrains Mono** (400, 500) only for UPPERCASE labels, data, numbers in tables and timestamps. No other fonts.
6. Headlines are two-tone: the setup in a dim grey, the payoff in full bone. Example: <dim>Every AI startup looks the same.</dim> Yours won’t.
7. Every section starts with a mono UPPERCASE label with a 5px orange square before it.
8. Square = label or list item. Circle = something live (a status dot).
9. No emoji, no sparkle or “AI” symbols, no stock 3D, no robots or glowing brains. Generated images follow the prompt library in section 8 and are never presented as real people or real work.
10. Copy is short, exact and true. No invented numbers, testimonials or client logos.

Sentence case everywhere except mono labels (UPPERCASE). Curly quotes and apostrophes (’ “ ”). Headlines `text-wrap: balance`. Max line length: about 40 characters for leads, 70 for body.

## 6. Components (use these classes on websites)

Wrap the page in `<body class="mm">` and load `tokens.css` then `brand.css`. Then:

| Class | What it is |
|---|---|
| `.mm-label` | Mono UPPERCASE eyebrow with the orange square. `.is-quiet` drops the square and dims it. |
| `.mm-display`, `.mm-h2`, `.mm-h3`, `.mm-h4`, `.mm-stat` | Headline sizes. Wrap the first half in `<span class="mm-dim">` for two-tone. |
| `.mm-lead`, `.mm-body-lg`, `.mm-small`, `.mm-micro` | Text sizes. |
| `.mm-btn.is-primary` | Orange pill button, 52px tall, dark text. **One per view.** |
| `.mm-btn.is-solid` | Bone button on black (ink on paper). Nav button, important secondary action. |
| `.mm-btn.is-ghost` | Hairline outline button. |
| `.mm-btn.is-sm` | 34px small button. |
| `.mm-link` | Inline link with an orange underline. |
| `.mm-chip`, `.mm-input`, `.mm-error` | Filter chips, pill inputs, error text. |
| `.mm-panel` | Raised panel with a hairline ring, 16px radius. |
| `.mm-window` + `.mm-window-bar` | Browser window frame for showing real work. Client brands stay inside it. |
| `.mm-dots` | 24px dotted workbench background. |
| `.mm-live` | Pulsing round status dot. |
| `.mm-section`, `.mm-container`, `.mm-split`, `.mm-frame` | Layout. |
| `[data-theme="paper"]` | Switches any element (or the whole page) to the Paper theme. |

Buttons say what happens, in the first person for the main action: “Plan my launch”, “See what’s included”, “Build my idea”. Never “Get started”, “Learn more” or “Click here”.

Icons: 16px grid, 1.6px stroke, round caps and joins, no fills, `currentColor`. Use only the set in `docs/brand/icons/` ({{ICON_COUNT}} icons: {{ICON_LIST}}). Never a sparkle, magic wand, robot or brain.

## 7. Signature elements

- **The label square:** 5px orange square before every mono label.
- **Two-tone headline:** dim setup, bone payoff.
- **The launch pass:** a paper ticket (`#F3F0E8`, 18px radius) with an orange header strip, mono labels “FROM · TO”, IDEA → LIVE, and a price. Used for pricing, offers and receipts.
- **Dotted workbench:** `.mm-dots` behind build logs and panels.
- **Copper light curtain:** soft vertical copper streaks rising from the bottom. Hero sections and campaign covers only, never on every section.
- **Grain:** 5% white noise on full-bleed dark areas only.
- **Browser window:** real client work, at real size, in `.mm-window` with a real URL in the bar.

## 8. Imagery

- Show real work (in a browser window), real people and hands at work, and the textures above.
- Two photo grades only: **natural** (saturation about 72%, warm light) or **duotone** (black `#0A0A0C` to bone `#F4F4F1`). One grade per layout.
- Text over a photo always sits on a dark gradient.
- Never: sci-fi AI renders, robots, glowing brains, circuit boards, handshake stock, 3D blobs, neon gradients, device mockups with fake UI, invented client logos, orange-tinted photos, mascots.

### Image prompt library

Every image prompt is: **[subject] + brand style + aspect ratio + avoid list.** Use these as they are, or write a new subject in the same shape. Describe a real scene a photographer could shoot; name the light, not the mood.

## 9. Voice and copy

We write like a founder talking to a founder: short sentences, real numbers, no hype.

- **Headlines:** setup, then payoff. “One price. No surprises.”
- **Numbers:** exact and true. “$500 to set up, $200 a month.” “Live in five business days.” Never invent stats, testimonials, client names or “10x”.
- **Words we use:** launch, kit, pass, founder, live, yours.
- **Words we never use:** revolutionary, unlock, seamless, supercharge, cutting-edge, AI-powered, game-changer, elevate, leverage, world-class, pixel-perfect, and emoji.
- **Names:** MuzMesh in text, muzmesh (lowercase) in the logo, MuzMesh Creative for the legal name. “Five days” in copy, “5 days” in labels.

Write: “A designer draws your logo, sets your brand and designs your page in Figma.”
Not: “Unlock your startup’s full potential with our AI-powered branding ✨”

## 10. Logo

- Files: `muzmesh-wordmark-light.svg` (bone, for black), `muzmesh-wordmark.svg` (ink, for paper or orange), `muzmesh-avatar.svg` (square “m.” for profiles), `muzmesh-favicon.svg`.
- Always use the files. If you cannot, set “muzmesh” lowercase in Inter Tight 700 at −0.015em, bone on black or ink on paper.
- Minimum width 72px. Clear space equal to the height of the “m”.
- Never orange, never a gradient, glow or outline, never next to a sparkle, never capitalised, stretched or re-tracked.

## 11. Recipes

### A web page or section

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,500&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="tokens.css"><link rel="stylesheet" href="brand.css">
</head>
<body class="mm">
  <section class="mm-section">
    <div class="mm-container mm-split">
      <div>
        <span class="mm-label">Pricing</span>
        <h2 class="mm-h2"><span class="mm-dim">One price.</span> No surprises.</h2>
      </div>
      <p class="mm-lead">$500 to set up, then $200 a month from the month after launch.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="mm-container" style="margin-top:56px">
      <a class="mm-btn is-primary" href="#plan">Plan my launch</a>
      <a class="mm-btn is-ghost" href="#included">See what’s included</a>
    </div>
  </section>
</body>
</html>
```

With Tailwind v4, import `tailwind-theme.css` and use `bg-mm-bg text-mm-text font-sans`, `text-mm-muted`, `bg-mm-accent text-mm-on-accent`.

If you cannot load the files, paste the CSS variables from section 12 into a `<style>` block and use them directly.

### A social post (1080×1350, 4:5)

- Black background (or Paper for contrast, or a duotone photo with a dark gradient).
- 86px margin. Mono label top left with the orange square. Two-tone headline, Inter Tight 500, about 100px, tracking −0.03em, max three lines. Wordmark bottom left, slide number or “Swipe →” bottom right in mono.
- One idea per post. Carousels: cover, point, list, proof, call to action; 6 to 8 slides.
- Feed mix: about half black, a quarter duotone photos, a quarter Paper. Never an orange background post.
- Captions: the first line is the headline, short sentences, one link, at most three hashtags at the end, alt text on every image.

### Sizes

| Asset | Size |
|---|---|
| Feed post, carousel slide | 1080×1350 |
| Square post (X, Facebook) | 1080×1080 |
| Story, reel cover | 1080×1920 (keep the top 250px and bottom 340px clear) |
| Link preview (OG) | 1200×630 |
| LinkedIn banner | 1584×396 (text starts 30% from the left) |
| X header | 1500×500 |
| Avatar | 800×800 |
| YouTube thumbnail | 1280×720 |
| Fiverr gig image | 1280×769 |

### A deck

Black slides, one headline per slide (two-tone), a mono label and slide number, lots of space. Paper slides for tables and pricing. 16:9.

### A document, proposal or invoice

Paper theme: `#F3F0E8` page, ink `#1D1D1F` text, muted `#595857`. Mono UPPERCASE labels, Inter Tight headings. Orange text or thin lines on paper use `#B33A06`. Use the launch pass for the price block. A4 or Letter.

### An email

Plain and short. Name, MuzMesh, one link in the signature. No image banners.
